# A Royals Towing LLC

> 24/7 towing and light-duty roadside assistance serving El Paso, TX and every area within 20 miles, including Horizon City, San Miguel, Lanark, Alton, Alvarado and Sunland Park, NM. Typical arrival is 30-60 minutes. Call or text dispatch at (915) 900-5680.

Licensed interstate carrier: USDOT 4041925, MC-1529690, with $1,000,000 liability coverage. Over 5 years of experience on the road. Open 24 hours, 7 days a week (often closed on major holidays, but emergencies are still answered).

## Services

- Towing: 24/7 emergency, local, long-distance and accident towing.
- Jump Start Service: quick jump starts for 12V and 24V systems.
- Lockout Services: safe, damage-free vehicle unlocking.
- Tire Change: spare tire installed on the roadside in minutes.
- Mobile Tire Replacement: new tire delivered and installed when there is no spare.
- Tire Repair: plug delivered and installed for a nail or puncture.
- Mobile Battery Replacement: new battery sold and installed on the spot.
- Fuel Delivery: enough fuel to reach the nearest gas station.
- Breakdown Service: roadside help when a vehicle dies on the road.
- Specialty work: stripped and locking lug nut removal, air delivery and tire inflation, heavy duty jump starts.

Not offered: mechanical repairs and rim repairs (referrals provided).

## Pricing

- Roadside assistance: starting at $65 (jump starts, lockouts, spare tire installs, fluid delivery).
- Mobile tire installation: $225-$265 for passenger vehicles with tire included; work and fleet trucks from $375.
- Mobile battery replacement: $189.99-$400.
- Stripped lug nut removal: from $75. Locking lug nut removal: from $85.
- Towing is quoted by distance and vehicle - call for an exact price.
- Lower written quote from another company? We will match it. All sales are final.

## Payment methods

Credit and debit cards, PayPal, Venmo, Cash App, Apple Pay, Google Pay and cash.

## Motor clubs and fleet networks accepted

Agero, Allied Dispatch Solutions, Nation Safe Drivers, Quest Roadside, Allstate, AAA, Roadside Protect, Good Sam Roadside, Mach 1 Services, Honk Technologies, RapiTow.
